project.title: Microbial Communities of Arctic Wastewater and Freshwater
project.description: The 16S rRNA gene sequences from wastewater and freshwater sampled in Baker Lake, Cambridge Bay, and Kugluktuk in Nunavut, Canada. This study aimed to profile the microbial communities of wastewater from Arctic waste stabilization ponds.
